This mixed international backdrop, coupled with a rising 10Y Yield at 4.50%, warrants caution. Despite the varied global picture, US market breadth remains resilient, with 56.2% of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day moving average and 61.8% above their 200-day.

Monitor the VIX at 16.20 for any unexpected spikes and the 10Y yield at 4.50% as a potential macro headwind. Prioritize trades with clear entry and exit levels.
